patches_modified.name: Change Facebook app theme (573)
patches_modified.description: Adds AMOLED Black and Material You palettes while preserving Facebook's light/dark mode selection.

patches_modified.name: Bypass anti-tamper
patches_modified.description: Stubs TBank's native RASP executor calls and neutralizes tamper flag reporting.

patches_modified.name: Remove TBank ads
patches_modified.description: Removes TBank stories and promotional surfaces.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ozon ads
patches_modified.description: Removes Ozon ad widgets, banner carousels, video ads, and PDP promo blocks.

patches_added.name: Galaxy XR legacy foundation (through 2.0.22/5002244)
patches_added.description: Selects the 16-patch Galaxy XR legacy set, including Meta Quest Pro identity, native gates, face bridge, OLED calibration, microphone, battery, Visual Delay, and XR foundation. High-resolution output is guarded to verified layouts; unavailable on 5001740, 5002172, and 5002206.

patches_added.name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.20/5001712)
patches_added.description: Applies the 16-patch Galaxy XR legacy set for exact Steam Link 2.0.20 build 5001712, including Meta Quest Pro identity, permission-free high resolution, and the Final balanced tested OLED profile.

patches_added.name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.22/5002318)
patches_added.description: Applies the existing native-Android-XR-safe Galaxy XR patch set for exact Steam Link 2.0.22 build 5002318.

patches_added.name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.22/5002322)
patches_added.description: Applies the validated permission-free Galaxy XR patch set for exact Steam Link 2.0.22 build 5002322, including the Final balanced tested OLED profile.

patches_removed.name: Video dither
patches_removed.description: Enables or disables VRLink video dithering, including the highp sRGB8 fallback and experimental RGB10_A2 shader variants.

patches_modified.name: Android XR native permission names
patches_modified.description: Replaces native Oculus face/eye permission checks with the Android XR permission names used by Galaxy XR, including the verified Steam Link 5001712 layout.

patches_modified.name: Device identity
patches_modified.description: Overrides the HMD identity reported to SteamVR. Recommended selects Meta Quest Pro for exact legacy bundle targets through 5002244, including 2.0.20/5001712; otherwise Galaxy XR. The Galaxy profile installs its complete transport identity while preserving stock controller/hand routing and extensions.

patches_modified.name: Force HMD initialization gates
patches_modified.description: Bypasses the two verified capability gates in QSVLDeviceHmd::Init for Steam Link builds 5001712, 5001740, 5002244, and 5002313.

patches_modified.name: Force lobby permission-state gate
patches_modified.description: Bypasses the verified permission-state gate in XrSceneLobby for Steam Link builds 5001712, 5001740, 5002244, and 5002313.

patches_modified.name: Force stream XR gates
patches_modified.description: Bypasses the three verified XR gates in builds 5001712, 5001740, and 5002244. Build 5002313 rewrote XrSceneStream::Init and is intentionally left unchanged.

patches_modified.name: GXR face bridge
patches_modified.description: Installs libgxr_face_bridge.so (XR_FB_face_tracking2 → XR_ANDROID_face_tracking API layer) and adds android.permission.FACE_TRACKING to the manifest. See the [GXR Face Bridge source](https://github.com/compdoge/gxr-face-bridge) and matching [Galaxy XR VRCFT module](https://github.com/compdoge/LinkFT).

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR high-resolution 3-projection fix
patches_modified.description: Permission-free resolution fix for exact builds 5001712, 5002244, 5002296, 5002313, 5002318, and 5002322. Preserves each build's native projection layout (2 layers on 2.0.20/5001712; 3 layers on supported 2.0.22 builds) and source formats, including future RGB10_A2, while appending a static 2x2 Android-surface compositor trigger with no image copy or reconstruction.

patches_modified.name: Microphone input preset
patches_modified.description: Selects the Android AAudio microphone processing mode used by Steam Link. Galaxy XR testing found Voice Recognition clearer and louder than stock Voice Communication.

patches_modified.name: OLED color calibration
patches_modified.description: Calibrates Galaxy XR OLED color and selects a guarded high-precision video output path for Steam Link builds 5001712, 5001740, 5002244, 5002313, 5002318, and 5002322.

patches_modified.name: Unrestricted battery usage
patches_modified.description: Opens Android's per-app Battery usage page at startup so Unrestricted can be selected for XR streaming.

patches_modified.name: Visual Delay Fix
patches_modified.description: Adds a configurable offset to the HMD OpenXR pose-query time and zeroes all six exported HMD velocity fields. Does not affect controller paths. Its trampoline uses a dedicated executable mapping over non-runtime ELF comment bytes and preserves live PLT entries.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR high-resolution 3-projection fix
patches_modified.description: Permission-free resolution fix for exact builds 5001712, 5002244, 5002296, 5002313, 5002318, and 5002322. The tested default preserves native projections and source formats, including future RGB10_A2, with a static 2x2 Android-surface quad. Optional 2.0.22/5002322 experiment replaces only the underside with a static black Surface-backed projection, keeping 3 total layers. No image copy or reconstruction. 2.0.20 remains unchanged.
